'''Cineratus''', born '''Jevan''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. His [[Cineratus's father|father]] chose the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] name of Cineratus for him, though Cineratus preferred his birth name. Wishing to stay independent, he became an agent of [[Darth Thanaton]] and was sent to [[Quesh]], claiming a want to "stay off Thanaton's hit list." He slew [[Corrin (Sith Empire)|Corrin]] and [[Kaal (Human)|Kaal]], apprentices of Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], and waited at the site of their deaths to slay their master. Upon Kallig's arrival, Cineratus insisted that his actions were not personally reflected and that he was only doing the job on Thanaton's behalf. He was killed by Kallig in the ensuing duel.
